caption: The drawing depicts a candle holder stand with two protruding arms, each holding a candle socket. The stand is primarily metallic in appearance, with elements colored in shades of brass and silver. The central vertical pole is straight and topped with a brass finial. About a third of the way down from the top, there are two horizontal arms extending outwards in opposite directions, each fitted with a brass candle holder. Below the arms and attached to the pole is a small rectangular component, possibly a mechanism for adjusting the arms. The base is composed of three curved legs, also metallic, radiating outward to provide stability, and connected to the pole with a round, flat brass element. The background is plain, off-white, and the objects are centrally positioned with no additional elements or ornamentation in the drawing.
title: Iron and Brass Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
